source_title: Xbox Game Pass Officially Has 7 Games Confirmed for November 2026
source_excerpt:
Xbox Game Pass subscribers can mark their calendars for the seven games that are confirmed to be coming to the Ultimate and PC tiers of the service in November 2026. New games are added to Xbox Game Pass on a regular basis, with the new additions spread out throughout each month. There will likely be many more games added to Xbox Game Pass in November, but subscribers only know about seven for certain.
2026 has been a strong year for Game Pass in terms of major new additions. Some of the highest-rated new game releases of 2026 have been added to Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass as day one releases, including the critically-acclaimed racing game Forza Horizon 6 and the recently-released Gears of War: E-Day . There's plenty more for Game Pass subscribers to look forward to as well, with the highly-anticipated Fable reboot set to be a day one game next year, among various other titles.
List of New Xbox Game Pass Games Coming in November 2026
In the more immediate future, there are seven games for Game Pass subscribers to look forward to in November 2026. Gravhounds will be added to Game Pass on November 2, while Pit of Goblin is coming on November 3. The 1.0 version of Void/Breaker will be added on November 4, Escape Academy 2 is coming on November 5 , and Football Manager 27 is coming on November 10 alongside Warhammer Survivors . And finally, Thronefall is confirmed for November 11. All of these games will be available to Xbox Series X/S and PC gamers, plus cloud versions will be available as well. Unfortunately for those that have yet to upgrade to newer hardware, none of the games currently confirmed for Game Pass in November 2026 will be released for Xbox One.

Out of all the new games coming to Xbox Game Pass in November, the one that I am personally most excited about is Escape Academy 2 . The first Escape Academy game is a fun co-op puzzler that is a blast to play in split-screen. Escape Academy 2 will also have local co-op , but it's open world this time around. An open world escape room sounds like it could be a very interesting evolution of the first game, and I am excited to see how it pans out. Being able to play it with an Xbox Game Pass Ultimate subscription is just icing on the cake.
Co-op gamers are eating good when it comes to the new Game Pass games for November 2026 . Gravhounds is a 1-4 player co-op game where players build bases, collect resources, and try to extract, all the while fighting alien creatures. The hook is that Gravhounds has players playing as anthropomorphic dogs. It will be a Game Preview/early access release when it is added to Game Pass on November 2, but should prove to be another solid game for co-op gamers to check out. Pit of Goblin , meanwhile, is a co-op horror game that is actually leaving early access when it launches on November 3 as a day one Game Pass game.
Game Pass subscribers should note that they will also be saying goodbye to some games in November. Following the batch of Game Pass games leaving on October 31 , another handful will be removed on November 15. What those games are remains to be seen, but subscribers should keep an eye out for more information on that front.
